steps.title: Verify Patient Inclusion Criteria
steps.instruction: Screen patients awaiting cesarean section based on specific inclusion criteria.

substeps.instruction: Confirm the planned anesthesia is subarachnoid.
If both criteria are not met, exclude the patient and record the unit in the non-inclusion count and the reason for non-inclusion.

steps.title: Obtain Informed Consent
steps.instruction: Execute the informed consent protocol with the volunteer.

substeps.instruction: Have the principal researcher and the volunteer sign two copies of the free and informed consent form (TCLE).
Provide one copy to the patient and retain one copy for the principal researcher.
